critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage and visible focus pass at all viewports; no touch-target violations or page-level overflow were measured. Reduced-motion testing found no changed elements. However, WCAG contrast remains unproven: axe reports serious incomplete contrast checks for 10 arena chart labels at tablet/mobile and 27 nodes at desktop, plus 12 unresolved mobile-header links. The screenshots also show very small, dim chart and metadata text. Tablet/mobile navigation clips off-screen items inside a horizontal rail, though all links remain keyboard-reachable.
critique.fix: Measure and correct contrast for every chart label, metadata label, and header link against its rendered background; enlarge the smallest chart/mono text where necessary. Add an obvious accessible cue and controls for the horizontally scrollable navigation, then rerun axe contrast, keyboard, touch-target, overflow, and reduced-motion tests with zero serious incomplete results.
